name: Profiles
short_desc: Your Wizard profile: share your build, look and App Store apps with friends, and try on theirs.
author: Humanity Labs
description: Share your build, your look and your App Store apps as Private, Friends or Everyone. Friends reach you over a private Tailscale connection; local apps never show.

form_fields.label: Your Tailscale login (who owns this profile)
form_fields.hint: The email you sign in to Tailscale with. Only this login can change your profile.

form_fields.label: Your friend link (optional)
form_fields.hint: The private address friends add, e.g. https://your-box.ts.net:8842/profiles/. Your agent sets this up.
